edition.title: Quod litteris ad te datis — Carolo Ludovico episcopo Rhedonensi de Lamennaisii epistola — Rome: Ex Typographia Polyglotta S. C. de Propaganda Fide, 1901.

work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Epistle CCLXXXII to Bishop Charles-Louis of Rennes (address LF48562–48563, protocol LF48566, salutation LF48569–48570) reports Lamennais's letter of 5 November, the pope's grief and his reply through Cardinal Pacca, urges vigilance for the doctrine of the encyclical and ends with its own 29 November 1833 closing at LF48663, before numeral CCLXXXIII (OCR CCLXXXII.) at LF48666. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF48566–48566; the source closing at LF48660–48663 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima nona novembris mille- simo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pontifica- tus Nostri anno tertio, LF48653 is a badly garbled body line (SEFUM' ESSEC >QUACN NOSILUME CST. …) whose WORDs occupy the printed line; it is retained literally, not restored. Its provenance note 1 (Ex Collectione Card. Falzacappa, LF48690–48691) is printed in CCLXXXIII's foot block and excluded there. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
